ZETACARD TRUST & SAFETY
Admin Control Panel
Review account activity, public-card reports, and moderation notes. Every admin action is recorded.
Privacy boundary: this panel never reveals passwords, reset tokens, or private authentication secrets. Review labels are internal notes; actual Suspend / Unsuspend actions go through a server-side Supabase Edge Function and are audited. An existing access token can remain usable until it expires, so use the platform controls for urgent incidents.

One hub for every connection.

Manage contacts, capture event leads, create email signatures, prepare meeting follow-ups, share profile links and connect your networking tools.

Contacts & lightweight CRM

Keep a searchable contact book with company, role, tags and follow-up notes. Contact records stay local until cloud sync is configured.

CSV import expects a header row. Recognized columns include name/full_name, email, phone, company, job_title/title, website, tags and notes. Export files are formula-injection protected.
The photo is sent to your configured AI provider only after you confirm. Verify every extracted field before saving. This does not search the web for additional personal data.
No contacts yet. Add one or import a CSV.

Event & lead-capture campaigns

Create a campaign link and collect consent-based enquiries. With the included database migration deployed, submissions from other devices are stored in your account. Without it, the public form explains that online capture is unavailable rather than silently losing leads.

No campaigns created yet.

Captured leads

Lead data is visible to the campaign owner after cloud setup and sign-in.

Branded email signature

Generate a lightweight HTML signature and matching meeting background. Copy the HTML into your mail client's signature editor; some clients require pasting the rendered signature instead of raw HTML.

LIVE PREVIEW
Fill in your details, then update the preview.
This generator creates static HTML. It does not automatically synchronize edits with email systems; signatures must be installed in each provider or deployed through a configured organization integration.

Meeting notes & follow-ups

Save meeting notes and next actions against a contact. The included local helper structures your notes; AI transcription and summarization need a deployed, secured AI provider connection.

Maximum 6 MB per clip in this version. Audio is sent to your configured AI provider only after you request transcription.
No meeting notes saved yet.

QR sharing, QR scanner & NFC

Create a QR code for a profile or campaign, scan QR codes with supported browsers, and write a link to compatible NFC tags where the device/browser permits. NFC writing is not available on every platform.

QR preview
Use HTTPS for browser camera/NFC access. A physical NFC card/tag is required; this button cannot create or purchase NFC hardware.
Scanner is stopped. On unsupported browsers, use your phone's camera or import contacts via CSV/vCard.

Company workspace

Create a shared workspace, invite colleagues by email, and see members. Invitations are copied as links; email delivery and automatic employee provisioning require separate server-side setup.

Sign in and apply the included migration to enable cloud workspaces.

Invite a teammate

Invitations only work when the database migration is installed and the invited email matches the signed-in account.

Integrations & export

Some connections are ready as file exports; OAuth-based CRM, wallet and AI services require credentials and server-side deployment. Never paste private API secrets into this HTML file.

AvailableCSV / Excel-compatible

Export contacts and leads for import into most CRM platforms.

AvailablevCard (.vcf)

Portable contact files for phonebooks and email clients.

Setup requiredSalesforce / HubSpot / Zoho / Pipedrive

Direct sync requires OAuth apps, server-side token storage and configured sync rules.

PartialEmail signature

Generate HTML and install it in your mail provider. Automatic centrally managed rollout is not connected.

Device support variesNFC tap sharing

Write a profile URL to a compatible tag from a supported HTTPS browser.

Credentials requiredApple Wallet / Google Wallet

Wallet passes must be signed and issued using legitimate developer credentials on a secure backend.

Server requiredAI Notetaker / enrichment

Audio transcription, AI summaries and external enrichment require a secured server function and explicit privacy controls.

Server requiredZapier / webhooks

Use server-side webhook relays to protect credentials and avoid exposing contact data in the browser.

Browser dependentOffline & installability

The hub keeps local records in browser storage. The main app still uses external scripts and online Supabase services.

Implementation boundary: this release adds functional contact, campaign, signature, meeting, QR/NFC and team tools where supported. It does not claim active third-party CRM sync, wallet issuance, contact OCR, automatic email delivery or AI transcription until the necessary provider credentials and server-side functions are configured.
